portraits.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: Paper Trails circular scientist portrait, The Wry Engraver.
Image 1 is the sole identity reference: Yakir Aharonov. Images 2 Rutherford, 3 Bohr, 4 Alfven supply approved graphic house style ONLY.
Newly draw Aharonov as an affectionate, recognisable editorial caricature. Recognition anchors: high square forehead under thick upright swept-back silver hair; intense dark eyebrows and gently knowing asymmetric gaze; neatly trimmed gray moustache and square short beard, long nose. Derive face and skin undertones from Image 1. Use a modestly enlarged head and compressed shoulders, keep caricature about 10–15%. Dress in muted burgundy collared shirt as photographed.
Remove all hands, pipe, chess pieces, table, clock, ornaments and room. A head-and-shoulders bust only, no props; the thoughtful expression supplies the humour.
Style: confident near-black blue-green ink outlines, simplified shapes, restrained flat colour, one shallow shadow tone, faint printed grain inside fills; crisp silhouette like the supplied house portraits. Natural fair skin with neutral-warm shadows, silver-gray hair and beard, burgundy shirt; never a blanket yellow, orange or sepia cast. Clearly drawn, not a colourised photograph, painterly airbrush or photorealism.
Composition: centred bust on square 1024x1024, crown about 8% down, eyes about 42% height, important facial features within the central 76%, safe at 42px grayscale and 92px circular crop. Entire face and beard must fit comfortably in the circle.
Background: genuine alpha transparency; empty pixels outside the bust; never draw or depict a checkerboard, transparency grid, studio backdrop, halo, or background colour.
PNG with decoded alpha; no text, watermark or signature, no equation, atom symbol, accessories, elaborate hatching, scene or full body. Identity must remain recognisable before humour.

Preserve age and recognisable expression without smoothing into a different person.
Composition: square 1024x1024 centered head-and-shoulders bust; important facial features remain safe within central 76% and 42px/92px circular crops.
Background: genuine alpha transparency; empty pixels outside the bust; never draw or depict a checkerboard, transparency grid, studio backdrop, halo, or background colour.
No additional props, hands, scene, text, watermark, signature or symbols. PNG with genuine alpha.
